criteria.ac: With `require_pinned_governor = true`, `verifyGrant` refuses every governed grant whose classification is not `pinned` with reason `grant-not-pinned`.
criteria.verified: Verified: test/commissaire-strict-mode.test.mjs (strict on: unpinned governor grant; in-process grant)

criteria.ac: With the flag false or omitted, the file absent, or the trust input `not_read`, every `verifyGrant` result equals FAFF-1178's result for the same inputs (a table-driven test compares full result objects across the existing FAFF-1178 test matrix with and without the strict-off trust file).
criteria.verified: Verified: test/commissaire-strict-mode.test.mjs (strict off, file absent and not-read leave every result identical; strict off with the file absent)

criteria.ac: `grant-not-pinned` is returned by `verifyGrant`; no new function, field or argument is added.
criteria.verified: Verified: commissaire-verify.ts diff adds only the grant-not-pinned reason and one branch; test/commissaire-verify.test.mjs (reasons only from GrantReason)

criteria.ac: A strict refusal reports the resolved `custody`, `classification` (`unpinned` or `in-process`), `signer_fingerprint`, `verdict_seq` and `trust_source`.
criteria.verified: Verified: test/commissaire-strict-mode.test.mjs (strict on: unpinned and in-process report the same fields as strict off)

criteria.ac: Strict mode never changes an existing refusal: with strict on, a governed run with no verdict for the step still reports `no-verdict-for-step`, a swapped `pk.json` still reports `governor-key-not-admitted`, an unpinned run whose latest verdict is a deny still reports `decision-not-a-grant`, and an orphaned unpinned grant still reports `chain-position-invalid`.
criteria.verified: Verified: test/commissaire-strict-mode.test.mjs (strict on never changes a refusal; swapped pk.json stays governor-key-not-admitted)

criteria.ac: Strict mode with an empty fingerprint list yields `trust-file-invalid` on a governed run.
criteria.verified: Verified: test/commissaire-strict-mode.test.mjs (empty fingerprint list refused by the reader: trust-file-invalid)

criteria.ac: An ungoverned run with strict mode on, including a run whose `commissaire/` directory was deleted, returns `not-applicable`; a test asserts it, so the accepted residual risk is pinned rather than accidental.
criteria.verified: Verified: test/commissaire-strict-mode.test.mjs (ungoverned run, and a run whose governance material was deleted, stay not-applicable)

criteria.ac: A pinned grant passes with strict mode on, from both a `local-ref` and a `remote-base` trust read.
criteria.verified: Verified: test/commissaire-strict-mode.test.mjs (pinned grant passes from local-ref and remote-base)

criteria.ac: No code path reads `require_pinned_governor` from anywhere but the `trust` argument.
criteria.verified: Verified: test/commissaire-strict-mode.test.mjs (the strict flag is read only from the trust argument)

criteria.ac: Tests cover strict on, strict off, trust file absent, and strict on with an empty list.
criteria.verified: Verified: test/commissaire-strict-mode.test.mjs (on, off, absent, empty list)

criteria.ac: With strict mode on, the merge, pr-create and branch-delete legs each refuse an unpinned governor grant and an in-process grant with reason `grant-not-pinned`, and pass a pinned grant (leg-level tests, after FAFF-1212).
criteria.verified: Verified: test/commissaire-strict-mode.test.mjs (three legs refuse unpinned and in-process grants with grant-not-pinned; pass pinned; trust-context-missing on all three legs)

criteria.ac: `npm run build` in `plugin/skills/faff` regenerates the `.js` emit and `build-manifest.json`; `faff regions check` and the full test suite pass.
